meta.title: Session Steward
meta.description: Session history files (archive browsing & cleanup) and session health checks (checkup → prescription → discharge) — reversible operations only, no touching of session logs.

en.card.enabled.desc: When off, no API is registered and the sidebar entry disappears.
en.card.health.desc: Checkup → Prescription → Discharge. When off, health routes and the tab are gone.
en.card.history.desc: Archive browsing and cleanup (Retirement Home). When off, history routes and the tab are gone.
en.card.readonly: This session cannot edit settings (read-only mount).
en.card.title: Session Steward
en.card.unavailable: Settings service unavailable; configuration cannot be read.
en.family.title: Screwdriver plugin settings
en.health.quarantined: Projection cache quarantined (refolds after a DSH restart)
en.health.sourceMigrateNone: No legacy signature rows to migrate
en.history.confirmPurge:
Purge the on-disk files of these {n} archived session(s)?

{summary}

About {size} will be freed.
This deletes: the transcript directory (including older-format copies) and the per-session projection cache, and removes them from the archive array and the workspace membership tables.

**This cannot be undone — the sessions will be unrecoverable.**
en.history.editingHint: Edit mode: tick sessions, then pick one — "Unarchive state" only removes them from the official archive array (reversible; they return to the sidebar after a restart); "Purge archive files" really deletes the transcript and projection cache from disk (irreversible).
en.history.pendingRestart: {n} archived id(s) are still live in host memory: the list follows the storage file (they are already gone), but their sessions stay hidden from the sidebar until DSH restarts.
en.history.purgeResult: Purged {purged} archived session(s), freed {size}. Restart DSH to make them disappear completely.
en.history.restartHint: Removed {removed} id(s) from the archive array ({remaining} left). **Restart DSH now**: until the host exits, any archive or workspace change rewrites the whole in-memory snapshot back to the file and undoes this.
en.history.source.none: The archive set is unreadable from both sources
en.panel.title: Session Steward
